captions.detailed: A De Dion rear axle assembly featuring a dark curved tube beam that connects two wheel hubs on either side. Each wheel hub is mounted on a revolute axle at the beam's ends, allowing them to spin independently. A central differential housing is positioned separately on a mounting bracket, with two short driveshaft stubs on revolute joints extending from its sides.
captions.instruction: Generate a De Dion rear suspension axle assembly. It should include a curved rigid tube beam connecting two rotatable wheel hubs, and a separate central differential housing mounted on a frame with two short output driveshafts that rotate on revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the rigid curved De Dion tube beam by sweeping or extruding a circular profile along a curved path, capped with cylindrical hub carriers at both ends. Model the wheel hubs using concentric cylinders and discs, attaching them to the beam ends via revolute joints. Create the central differential housing using a combination of a central sphere/cylinder and lateral flanges, mounted to a rectangular frame, and attach two short cylindrical driveshafts via revolute joints on each side.
